title: The 8 best AI demo agents in 2026 (plus 3 tour tools adding AI)
summary: Compare the best AI demo agents in 2026: Karumi, Naoma, Floe, Hobbes, Hyper AI, Demoloop, LiveDemo, Consensus. What buyers see, prices, pros and cons.
body_markdown:
The best AI demo agents in 2026 are Karumi, Naoma, Floe, Hobbes, Hyper AI, Demoloop, LiveDemo and Consensus. Pick Karumi for an autonomous agent that shows each buyer your real product live, and Naoma, Hyper AI or Demoloop for a published price and a self-serve start.


Karumi is an AI demo agent: an autonomous agent that shows a buyer your real product live, by voice or chat, and answers questions as it goes. Navattic, Storylane and Supademo now add AI agents to captured tours, so we list them as a separate group.

## What is an AI demo agent?


An AI demo agent gives a product demo to a buyer without a sales rep. It talks with the buyer, shows the screens that match their questions and decides the next step, such as booking a meeting ([full definition](https://karumi.ai/blog/what-is-an-ai-demo-agent) ). The key difference between tools is what the buyer sees. Some agents drive your real product. Others present a captured copy, slides or a recorded tour. A copy is easier to control. The real product shows what your software does today.


## How did we evaluate the tools?


We checked every tool in November 2026, on its own pricing and product pages, against six questions:


1. **What does the buyer see?** Live product, captured copy, slides or video.
2. **How does the agent talk?** Chat, voice, avatar or a video call.
3. **Where does it run?** Website, links, outbound email, live calls.
4. **What happens after?** Qualification, booking, CRM sync.
5. **What does it cost?** Public price, or "quote only".
6. **How hard is setup?** Self-serve, or a guided pilot.


We are Karumi, so Karumi is first, with its weak points.


## Which AI demo agents run the demo for the buyer?


### 1. Karumi


Karumi's agent is autonomous: it understands your product, decides what to show live in the real product and adapts to each buyer. It is not a recording, a replica or a guided tour ([live or recording?](https://karumi.ai/blog/is-karumi-demo-live-or-recording) ).


- **Best for:** B2B SaaS teams that want one agent for the website, outbound and live calls.
- **Price:** Quote only. Growth and Enterprise plans are priced on agents, demo volume, languages and integrations, and most teams start with a pilot ([pricing](https://karumi.ai/pricing) , checked November 2026).
- **Pros:** Voice and chat. It[joins Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls](https://karumi.ai/blog/can-karumi-join-google-meet-zoom-teams-calls) and runs in[the buyer's language](https://karumi.ai/blog/which-languages-does-karumi-support) . One agent works from a demo link, a website widget, a chat bar or a cold email. It books the meeting with the right rep and syncs sessions to HubSpot, Salesforce and Attio ([what Karumi sends to HubSpot](https://karumi.ai/blog/what-does-karumi-send-to-hubspot) ). Enterprise adds on-premise deployment and SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR.
- **Cons:** No public price and no self-serve plan, so you start with a call. Because the agent works in your real product, your demo account needs clean sample data.


### 2. Naoma


[Naoma](https://naoma.ai/pricing) is an AI video sales agent that presents your product with a voice and an avatar. It bills per engaged demo.


- **Best for:** Small teams that want to start without a sales call.
- **Price:** Starter $249/mo billed annually for 50 engaged demos; Growth $750/mo for 100; Scale $2,083/mo for 300; Enterprise custom (checked November 2026).
- **Pros:** Self-serve Starter. Clear unit price. Growth adds the live product, booking and multilingual demos.
- **Cons:** Starter demos are built from slides and screenshots, not the product. The live product walkthrough starts at $750/mo. SSO and a security review are Enterprise only.


### 3. Floe


[Floe](https://floe.so/compare/best-ai-demo-agents) drives your real product in a real browser with a demo account, in a voice-led demo with live qualification.


- **Best for:** A voice-led demo of the real product on your website.
- **Price:** Not published; Floe's site says it is tailored to demo volume (checked November 2026).
- **Pros:** Real product, real browser. Text or voice on the website, optional video avatar.
- **Cons:** No public price; the pricing page leads to a booking form.


### 4. Hobbes


[Hobbes](https://www.hihobbes.com/) says it "navigates your product live, answers questions, and explains each step in your voice." It can also pull a slide from your decks or draw a chart from the conversation.


- **Best for:** One agent for buyers, new users and customers.
- **Price:** Not published ([pricing](https://www.hihobbes.com/pricing) , checked November 2026).
- **Pros:** Live product plus slides and on-the-fly charts. Integrations with HubSpot, Attio, Salesforce, Slack and Gong.
- **Cons:** No public price, and few public details on languages.


### 5. Hyper AI


[Hyper AI](https://attio.com/apps/hyper-ai) puts an agent on a video call that shows your real product on screen and answers questions, in 25+ languages. A second agent onboards new users inside the product.


- **Best for:** Teams that sell on video calls and want a low entry price.
- **Price:** Starter €149/mo, Growth €349/mo, Pro €649/mo, Enterprise custom; 7-day free trial with 50 minutes; 20% off billed yearly ([pricing](https://gethyper.ai/pricing) , checked November 2026).
- **Pros:** Low flat entry price, a free trial, and Zoom, Meet and Teams.
- **Cons:** Built around the video call. Check how it works on your website before you buy.


### 6. Demoloop


[Demoloop](https://getdemoloop.com/pricing) is an AI product demo agent for SaaS websites. It turns serious product visits into voice-led demos.


- **Best for:** Teams that want to pay by usage first.
- **Price:** Pay as you go at $0 + $0.90/min; Starter $249/mo; Growth $699/mo; Enterprise custom (checked November 2026).
- **Pros:** Start privately for free. Per-minute billing keeps a pilot cheap.
- **Cons:** The pricing page does not say whether the agent drives the live product or a captured copy. Ask before you buy.


### 7. LiveDemo


[LiveDemo](https://livedemo.ai/pricing) is an interactive demo platform with an AI demo agent. The agent answers from your docs and shows the right captured demo, by chat, voice or a live video avatar.


- **Best for:** Budget-minded teams, and teams that want to self-host.
- **Price:** Free plan; Pro $27/creator/mo; Growth $39/creator/mo, both billed annually; Business custom. The agent is in Growth, with 60 avatar minutes a month (checked November 2026).
- **Pros:** Very low price. Source-available code you can host yourself. HubSpot, Slack and webhooks.
- **Cons:** The buyer sees captured demos, not your live product. Growth allows one live avatar conversation at a time.


### 8. Consensus


[Consensus](https://goconsensus.com/pricing) started with video demos and now combines interactive tours, AI demo agents, video and live demos in one experience.


- **Best for:** Teams that already send video demos.
- **Price:** From $600/mo; per-user licenses plus optional usage-based features (checked November 2026).
- **Pros:** Mature platform for personalized video and tour demos inside a deal.
- **Cons:** The agent sits on top of videos and captured demos. G2 reviewers cited by[Navattic](https://www.navattic.com/blog/best-ai-demo-software) mention a learning curve at setup. See[Karumi vs Consensus](https://karumi.ai/blog/karumi-vs-consensus) .


## Which demo tour tools are adding AI agents?


These tools build click-through tours from captured screens and now add an agent that answers questions over them. They fit teams that already own a tour library.


### Navattic


Navattic Agents "guide and qualify prospects, answer questions, demo key workflows," on a product clone mixed with slides.


- **Price:** Starter is free with one demo; paid plans are billed annually; agents are "based on number of conversations and agents" and include the Base plan ([pricing](https://www.navattic.com/pricing) , checked November 2026).
- **Pros:** Strong build tools and AI help to write tours.
- **Cons:** The agent shows a clone, and Navattic's own post says it "isn't a full replica of your product." See[Karumi vs Navattic](https://karumi.ai/blog/karumi-vs-navattic) .


### Storylane


Storylane's RepX is a website agent that qualifies visitors and opens the right Storylane demo by text, voice or video.


- **Price:** Demo Suite is free, then from $40/mo billed yearly; RepX from $1,250/mo for up to 10,000 monthly visitors ([pricing](https://www.storylane.io/pricing) , checked November 2026).
- **Pros:** Free tour plan, clear RepX price.
- **Cons:** RepX can only show what your team captured. See[Karumi vs Storylane](https://karumi.ai/blog/karumi-vs-storylane) .


### Supademo


Supademo sells an AI Demo Agent add-on on its tour plans.


- **Price:** Free plan; paid plans from $38/mo per creator billed annually; the agent includes 1,500 free credits, then about 20 credits per demo call ([pricing](https://supademo.com/pricing) , checked November 2026).
- **Pros:** 1,500 free agent credits to test with.
- **Cons:** Credits make the monthly cost harder to predict. See[Karumi vs Supademo](https://karumi.ai/blog/karumi-vs-supademo) .

Compare the unit, not only the price. Per-minute billing is cheap for a pilot and costly at scale. Per-visitor billing grows with traffic, even when nobody talks to the agent.


## How do you choose the right AI demo agent?


Start with what the buyer should see.


- **Your real product, live, on every channel:** Karumi.
- **A self-serve start with a public price:** Naoma, Hyper AI or Demoloop.
- **A voice demo of the real product on your website:** Floe or Hobbes.
- **An agent on top of tours you already built:** Navattic, Storylane, Supademo or LiveDemo.
- **Video demos inside a deal:** Consensus.


In our experience, buyers ask to see specific features work in their own case, not a general overview. That favors agents that can open any part of the product. Before you sign, ask each vendor what the buyer sees, what happens when your interface changes and which CRM fields it fills. For tour tools, see the[best interactive demo software](https://karumi.ai/blog/best-interactive-demo-software) .


## FAQ


### What is the best AI demo agent in 2026?


Karumi is the best fit for an autonomous agent on the real product across website, outbound and live calls. Naoma and Hyper AI are the easiest to buy online.


### Which AI demo agents show the real product?


Karumi, Floe, Hobbes and Hyper AI say their agents work in your real product. Naoma does it from its Growth plan. Navattic, Storylane, Supademo and LiveDemo show captured demos.


### How much does an AI demo agent cost?


As of November 2026, LiveDemo includes an agent from $39 per creator a month, and dedicated agents start at €149 a month (Hyper AI) or $249 (Naoma, Demoloop). Karumi, Floe and Hobbes quote on a call.


### Can an AI demo agent join a sales call?


Yes. Karumi joins Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls, and Hyper AI runs its demos on Zoom, Meet or Teams calls. Most other tools work on the website or from a link.


### Do AI demo agents work in other languages?


Many do. A Karumi demo link sets the demo language, Hyper AI lists 25+ languages and Naoma adds multilingual demos on Growth.


Want to see an AI demo agent work on a real product? Try a live demo at[karumi.ai/demos](https://karumi.ai/demos) .
